messages:
Ravi (People Ops): New manager starts Monday; putting together a compact "Sprint Zero" onboarding checklist. Can folks confirm must-haves for Day 0/1?

Maya (HR): Must include ID for payroll, benefits link, manager handbook pdf, and manager training sign-up for week 2.

Carlos (IT): I'll pre-stage laptop and SSO. Common snag: SCIM group sync. If access delayed >2h, ping me + Onboarding Bot to open a triage call.

Asha (Hiring Manager): Add immediate contacts list: payroll, security, infra lead. Also who approves 30/60/90? I prefer skip-level signoff.

Sam (Eng Manager): Add quick "first-week manager checklist": meet directs, review last 3 retros, set 1:1s, check alerting/runbook owners.

Ravi (People Ops): Draft Sprint Zero (short): Day -2 email, Day 0 pre-provision, Day 1 welcome + team intros, Day 2 30/60/90 sketch, End week review. Will circulate a one-pager.

Onboarding Bot: Reminders scheduled: Day -2 email, Day 1 agenda, Day 7 check-in.

Maya (HR): I'll assign a buddy and confirm payroll before day 5.

Carlos (IT): Creating IT ticket now; will post link when done.

Ravi (People Ops): Thanks all 64; final packet by EOD tomorrow. Drop any sample 30/60/90s here if you have them.
